scope: Assigned frozen item titles and complete ItemBodies; all assigned original-resolution screenshot tiles; supplemental independent inspection of two coordinator-nominated diagnostic tiles.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully; SCHEMA.md and WORKFLOW.md read for schema and rendering/TikZ context.
review_method.rendering: Every assigned local PNG tile was opened individually with tools.view_image at original resolution; no downscaling or collage. The two additional diagnostic originals were also opened individually. No HTTP/live website was used.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: Every frozen item title/full ItemBody was read in the byte-identical current source and frozen snapshot and compared with assigned HTML and all hashes.
review_method.boundary: No item/app/tool edits; no publication-status changes; no tests/build/native/commit/push/network. Only lane-04.json and lane-04.md written.

supplemental_visual_checks.visible_result: A red diagram-failure panel appears after the prose saying the ordinary associator pentagon is represented schematically. Its text contains a failed tikzcd pentagon with associators a_{A,B,C⊗D}, a_{A⊗B,C,D}, a_{A,B,C}⊗1_D, a_{A,B⊗C,D}, and 1_A⊗a_{B,C,D}. The original tile confirms the metadata failure visually; no diagram is rendered.
supplemental_visual_checks.math_note: Source labels encode the standard pentagon paths with associators in the expected direction, but the failed tikzcd grid syntax produces an error panel. No rendered commutativity picture is available.

supplemental_visual_checks.visible_result: Multiple source blocks that should be typeset equations instead show literal LaTeX commands, raw dollar delimiters, and red prose/error fragments. The second original tile continues the defect in maps/equations and the diagram-convention TikZ source. The visual break is extensive and consistent with reported KaTeX parse errors; metadata alone was not used as proof.
supplemental_visual_checks.math_note: The displayed textual claims distinguish typed domains/codomains and reverse labels A_ba/A_ab, but the broken equations prevent a reliable visual check of those map types or signs from the rendered tile.
supplemental_visual_checks.diagram_note: The tile also shows the unrendered tikzcd fence at source lines 140–143 as literal source. The composites stated in the diagram convention (line 138) both have type A⊗A→A⊗A: Δ∘μ, and (1⊗μ)∘α∘(Δ⊗1). Their source-level orientation/composition is coherent; no rendered arrows were available to inspect.
